runs.name: matrix
runs.environment: Installed Microsoft Edge, headless Playwright mobile/touch emulation, four CSS viewport sizes. Full matrix uses keyboard-operated native range controls. Supplemental 200% root-text override is explicitly browser-text emulation. Rail plan uses EW8 to EW12 on 2026-09-21 10:00 SGT; long-address provider data are labelled synthetic. Street tiles blocked. No physical-device, live-provider, OS text scaling or actual browser settings claim.
